text.title: Multi-Platform Design Parity Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on how many surfaces are meant to hold the same decisions, whether one generated token source resolves to each platform's primitives, and whether the surfaces differ in input model — separating a matrix that can prevent drift from one that could only record it.

decision-tree.root-question: How many product surfaces are meant to hold the same design decisions?

conclusion.verdict: skip; there is no second surface for an invariant to hold across

branch.when: several surfaces, but deliberately different products with different information architecture — a marketing site and an operator console

conclusion.verdict: skip; parity over intentionally divergent products manufactures drift entries for differences that are the design

branch.when: two or more surfaces intended to be the same product
branch.question: Is there a single generated token source — DTCG JSON through Style Dictionary or equivalent — resolving to each platform's own primitives?

branch.when: no shared source; each platform's token file is hand-maintained and edited independently

conclusion.verdict: skip for now; run cross-platform-token-distribution first — a matrix over hand-maintained files records drift it has no mechanism to prevent

branch.when: one source generates CSS custom properties, iOS constants and the Android theme, but some tokens have no named primitive on a listed surface

conclusion.verdict: apply, but treat every unnamed cell as unresolved rather than as parity; the token map must state the concrete output primitive per tier per surface before any score is published

branch.when: one generated source resolves every listed token to a named primitive on every surface
branch.question: Do the surfaces differ in input model or viewing distance — touch against pointer against remote control, wearable, ten-foot?

branch.when: yes; hover, long-press, swipe-to-delete or text entry has no native equivalent on at least one surface

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology and resolve every gap cell explicitly: a named substitute interaction plus its discoverability affordance, or 'not offered on this surface' with the reason — a blank cell fails

branch.when: no; the same input model and density tier apply across every surface

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; each row declaring invariant plus permitted variance, density tiers carrying base unit and scale factor, overrides typed with expiry releases, parity score published with its formula and cell counts
